author: krisoshea.eth
content:
Hey everyone, I hope you are all well. Apologies I can’t make the call today. I’ve just started my master’s today and unfortunately my classes clash with the call, so I’m dropping my Week 12 update here. I hope thats ok

Over the past week Marko and I have been working on the Lodestar Builder’s payload and bidding flow, taking Nico’s prototype as a starting point and turning it into smaller implementations for review.

That covers requesting and storing execution payloads, coordinating build jobs, tracking proposer preferences and bid commitments, and constructing and submitting bids. We’ve also worked on matching selected bids to our local records and assembling, signing and publishing the payload envelope.

On my fork of the lodestar repo, I’ve started connecting the build, storage and bidding components through a SlotBidder coordinator, including balance checks and duplicate-submission handling. I also drafted the payload-attributes changes that expose the beacon node’s safe and finalized execution hashes, alongside the Beacon APIs proposal.

A lot of the work has gone into testing cancellation, timeouts, conflicting requests, Gloas/Heze handling and safe reveal retries. I’ve also contributed storage and bid-policy work to Marko’s open PRs, and continued the beacon block observer and Builder lifecycle regression tests i was working on a few weeks ago.

Alongside the code, I’ve updated our planning docs and issue board and we have continued the Beacon APIs selection-event discussion. this week we will work on finishing the runtime wiring and testing the complete flow across beacon nodes. Cheers!
